meta.title: Prerana Jain — Frontend & Data/ML Engineer
meta.description: Portfolio of Prerana Jain — frontend developer moving into data, ML, and system design.

hero.titleHtml: Hi, I'm Prerana — I build clean interfaces and I'm going deeper into data & systems.
hero.lead: I started out as a frontend developer and now work across data and machine learning too. Lately I'm drawn to system design and the architecture behind good data engineering.

paragraphs: My path started on the frontend — turning designs into fast, accessible interfaces. Over time I got pulled toward what happens behind the UI: the data, the models, and the systems that make products actually work at scale.

Today I split my time between building interfaces and working on data and ML problems. To do the data-engineering side well, I keep studying system design and architecture — how to move data reliably, model it sensibly, and keep things maintainable.
I like work that connects both worlds: a thoughtful interface on top of a well-designed system.
